'''Montserrat García Riberaygua'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|García|Riberaygua}} (born 26 November 1989 in [[Andorra la Vella]]) is an [[Andorra]]n [[whitewater slalom|slalom canoer]] who has competed since the mid-2000s. She was eliminated in the qualifying round of the [[Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's slalom K-1|K-1]] event at the [[2008 Summer Olympics]] in [[Beijing]], finishing in 20th place.<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ga/montserrat-garcia-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203053034/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ga/montserrat-garcia-1.html |archive-date=2016-12-03 |quote=Full name: Montserrat García Riberaygua}}</ref>
